simple.meaning: רָזֶה (râzeh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “thin.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Numbers, Ezekiel, beginning at Numbers 13:20. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָזֶה (H7330).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H7330. razeh [ רָזֶה ] adjective lean (on formation compare Lag BN 49 ); — feminine singular רָזָה , Ezek 24:20 (of שֶׂה ; opposed to בִּרְיָה ), of land, = barren, Num 13:20 (J E; opposed to שְׁמֵנָה ).
